commit_message:
[wasm] Introduce WasmModuleSignatureStorage

This replaces a Zone we used for storing signatures, array types, and
struct types. Zones are meant for temporary storage and are not very
memory efficient.

The new WasmModuleSignatureStorage provides pointer stability and a
similar interface than a zone, but has less memory overhead.

R=jkummerow@chromium.org

fix_commit_message:
[wasm] Fix data race on WasmModuleSignatureStorage

The same race existed before on the `signature_zone_`, but looks like it
was less likely to trigger.

It's very unintuitive that `WasmModule::signature_storage` is protected
by `NativeModule::allocation_mutex_`, but that's how it is.

Drive-by: Remove the actual signature storage size from
`EstimateStoredSize` which otherwise only reports the size of decoded
information. Add it to `EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption` instead.

R=jkummerow@chromium.org

Fixed: 482345688

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix e194d3a40d8e on top of intro b9068d13bb1c via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (DataRace): V8's WebAssembly implementation stores per-module function signatures (and related C++ fast-API call signatures added during instantiation) in a `WasmModuleSignatureStorage` object held as a `mutable` field on the otherwise-const `WasmModule` struct. This storage can be appended to concurrently during module instantiation on one thread while another thread (e.g. performing `performance.measureMemory()` / memory-consumption tracing) reads its size via `WasmModule::EstimateStoredSize()` / `EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()`. The code that mutates `signature_storage` is correctly protected by `NativeModule::allocation_mutex_`, but the code that reads it for memory estimation purposes was not holding that same mutex, creating a data race on the underlying vector-of-vectors storage. Root cause: When `signature_zone` (a Zone) was replaced by the custom `WasmModuleSignatureStorage` class in commit b9068d13bb1, the new class's `TotalReservedSize()` accessor was invoked from `WasmModule::EstimateStoredSize()`/`EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` exactly as the old Zone accessor had been — i.e., without any synchronization — even though the class's own doc comment states that `signature_storage` is mutated during instantiation on a `const WasmModule`. The call chain `NativeModule::EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` → `module_->EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` executes before `NativeModule::allocation_mutex_` is acquired in that function, so a concurrent instantiation thread appending to `signature_storage` races with the reading thread.
